email_body:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm applying for the UI/UX Designer role in Ghent. Your focus on building a design system from the ground up and redesigning dense, complex pages immediately caught my attention—it's exactly the kind of hands-on UI work I enjoy.

In my current freelance and agency work, I design and build websites end to end: from site structure and component consistency to accessible markup and clean visual hierarchy. I've created a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages, designed Shopify stores, and built a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero. I use Figma and AI tools like Claude daily to speed up prototyping, and I'm comfortable with HTML/CSS. I'm fluent in English and based in Belgium.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Qargo turn its design system into a robust foundation.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer position in Ghent. The opportunity to be your first dedicated designer and own a design system from the ground up is precisely the kind of challenge I'm looking for. Your emphasis on strong UI skills, dense application pages, and direct customer contact aligns closely with how I like to work.

My background combines design and front-end implementation. As a freelancer and junior digital marketer, I've designed and built websites end to end—from site structure and visual hierarchy to accessible markup and component consistency. For a pharmacists' association, I created a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages, ensuring clarity and usability at scale. I've also designed Shopify stores, built a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, and maintained design consistency across WordPress builds. This hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript means I understand how designs translate into code, which helps when maintaining consistency between a design system and front-end components.

I use Figma regularly for design work and rely on AI tools like Claude daily to speed up research, prototyping, and audits. I'm comfortable designing for dense, complex interfaces and enjoy bringing order to components that have grown inconsistent over time. I also value direct customer contact—having built sites for clients and gathered feedback through iterative audits, I know how customer conversations shape better design decisions.

I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and eager to work closely with product owners and engineers. I'd love to discuss how I can help Qargo build a robust design foundation.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
